Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 20:12:00 -0400
From: Taylor Green <taylor.green@acme.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Lee Chen <lee.chen@mediamark.com>
Subject: Demo request — US morning preference (timezone note)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We'd like to schedule a live product walkthrough next week. Our decision-makers are on the US East coast and prefer morning slots (9–11am EDT).

A couple of constraints:
- We also have a technical lead (Lee Chen) in APAC who can join late if needed (but prefers not to be past 23:00 local).
- We know Redwood has EU folks; happy to meet mid-day CEST if that maps to our morning.

Can you propose 2–3 concrete slots (with time zone conversions) and any fallback options if APAC can't make it?

Goal: 45-minute demo + 15 minutes for Q&A and next steps.

Thanks,
Taylor Green
Director, Product — Acme Corp
T: +1 555-0142

Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 01:03:00 +0200
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Green <taylor.green@acme.com>
Cc: Lee Chen <lee.chen@mediamark.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Demo request — US morning preference (timezone note)

Hi Taylor — thanks, this is helpful.

Quick availability from the Redwood EU demo team (CEST): typically 14:00–19:00 CEST on weekdays. Conversions that map to your US morning window:
- 15:00 CEST = 09:00 EDT / 06:00 PDT
- 16:00 CEST = 10:00 EDT / 07:00 PDT
- 17:00 CEST = 11:00 EDT / 08:00 PDT

Two immediate proposals (both 60-min blocks including Q&A):
1) Thu 20 May — 15:00 CEST / 09:00 EDT (Jonas to run high-level demo; Ben to join for commercial Qs)
2) Wed 19 May — 17:00 CEST / 11:00 EDT (later slot if you want more overlap with APAC)

Operational notes / fallback plan:
- Rotating host: if APAC participation becomes required, we can rotate the technical deep-dive to our APAC engineer and split the session (40-minute exec demo + 20-minute tech deep-dive).
- Recording: we'll record the session and share short clips of the product flows for any participants who cannot make the live Q&A.
- Invite: I'm drafting a calendar invite and a short MAP (attached) that lists decision milestones and owners.

Attachments: MAP-Acme-20270516.pdf (mutual action plan draft). I'll attach the calendar invite once final slot confirmed.

If either of the two options above works, confirm the preferred slot and I'll put an invite on the calendar and loop in Hiro (APAC engineer) for the tech segment where needed.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:45:00 +0200

Thanks for the options, Jonas. Two quick operational comments from my side:

- Split-run approach: We've found the 40/20 split gives DM-level folks the overview they need and gives engineers the space for deeper Qs without running late. If Taylor prefers a single 60-min block we can do that too.
- DST/availability: May is DST everywhere — please note Pacific attendees might see an early start (6–7am PDT). If that's a blocker for APAC, we can move the tech deep-dive to a separate 30-min follow-up with Hiro.

Ben — can you confirm commercial attendees and whether a procurement lead should be included on the invite?

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Hi Taylor — happy to host the commercial portion. I can make Thu 20 May at 09:00 EDT.

Plan I propose:
- 09:00–09:40 EDT: Product walkthrough (Jonas) + commercial overview (me)
- 09:40–10:00 EDT: Tech Q&A / optional deep-dive (Hiro will join remotely if available; if not, we'll schedule a short follow-up with him)

I've created and sent the calendar invite (redwood-demo-invite.ics) for Thu 20 May 09:00 EDT / 15:00 CEST. Please accept; invite includes a short agenda and the MAP link.

If APAC needs earlier/later times, we can also offer a split where the tech session is a separate 30-min block scheduled within 48 hours after the main demo.

Thanks,
